endorsements.quote: Initial governance steps entail (1) organizing decision-makers to prioritize educational AI use-cases and (2) setting up technical capabilities to evaluate AI tools.

With the proper resources in place, recurring governance activities include (1) piloting, (2) implementing, and (3) evaluating AI tools over time to understand how well the algorithm performs within a local setting and whether an intervention tied to an algorithm is effective.

unlisted_practices: Apply Evidence-Centered Design to assessment development to document student, task, and evidence models and address construct-irrelevant variance and underrepresentation.
Combine ratings from multiple encounters, adjusting for rater stringency, when summarizing workplace-based assessment evidence.
Use implementation research frameworks and checklists to identify barriers to technology-based assessment before adoption.
Assess the consequential validity of AI-driven assessment systems, with increasing attention as stakes and automation rise.

screen.reason: This paper provides commentary and framework recommendations on the integration of assessment technologies and clinical AI governance in health professions workplace-based assessment.
